title: Clinical Trials
description: Clinical trial search and status from ClinicalTrials.gov
summary: Clinical trial search and status from ClinicalTrials.gov
offersHint: Clinical trial search and status from ClinicalTrials.gov · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://clinical.memoryapi.org/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_trials
toolsPreview.description: Search clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, intervention, sponsor, status, or phase. Returns trial IDs, titles, status, phases, conditions, interventions, enrollment, and locations count.

toolsPreview.name: get_trial_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific clinical trial by NCT ID. Returns title, summary, description, eligibility criteria, primary/secondary outcomes, sponsor, collaborators, locations, and results summary if available.

toolsPreview.name: get_trial_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get clinical trial statistics and trends for a condition. Returns counts by status (recruiting, completed, etc.), by phase, and top sponsors. Useful for: "How many Alzheimer's trials are recruiting right now?"
